description: SUPERSEDED 2006 - Ipswich Planning Scheme Overlay - OV3 Mining Influence Areas is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ipswich City Council. Contents This Dataset contains the following superseded 2006 maps (For the latest 2025 Ipswich Planning Scheme please go to isoplan. com. au/eplan): 1. Mining Influence Constrained Areas 2. Surface Disturbance - Including Open-Cut Mining 3. Areas Affected by Underground Mining 4. Shaft 5. Coverage: Ipswich City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Ipswich City Council. Its tags are Ipswich City, Planning Policies, Planning Scheme, Planning Zones, Town Planning. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, kml, shp, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
